g.text: Group-in-group credit assignment for multi-turn agents
Same shopping task x + initial state S
N environment copies; one rollout policy
State key S → all matching occurrences
Offline hash grouping reuses collected actions.
One macro signal shared across an episode
Future return, not just immediate reward
F = std or 1; toy example below uses F = 1.
Different steps can get different credit.
No learned critic or per-state resampling
Reference policy supplies the KL anchor.
Schematic N = 2, T = 3 with sparse terminal reward; values rounded. Blue dashed: refresh old policy.
